reason: Classified as a memory/context plugin because its core behavior is enabling users to carry context between DSH sessions: create and share session references, pick sessions from an @ mention UI, and read prior sessions as readable transcripts. Security risk is moderate since it provides access to session conversation data, though it is constrained to local read-only operations per the plugin description.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中跨会话共享上下文，可一键复制会话引用、通过 `@` 选择会话，并用 `session_read` 将会话内容以可读对话文本展示。
summaries.en: This plugin enables cross-session context sharing in DeepSeek Harness by letting users copy session references, pick sessions via @ mentions, and read selected sessions as readable conversation text with `session_read`.

capabilities: Reads local session content via host APIs and returns a projected conversation transcript.
Resolves cross-session references (`@session-<uuid>`, `dsh-session:` URI, or `@title`) to load another session into the current context.
Copies session identifiers to clipboard and renders session mentions as UI chips in composer/chat views.

reasons.code: README states the plugin provides a `session_read` tool returning `sessionId`, `title`, `cwd`, `logPath`, `seqRange`, `transcript`, and `truncated`, enabling retrieval of other session content.
README declares reading is read-only and notes no writes to on-disk logs, but it does expose session log content to another session through projection.

README and package metadata show web UI integration (copy button, @mention source, skills declaration) and tool wiring in the DSH plugin manifest, confirming this cross-session context workflow in-app.
